title: Repair question bank: the six most common mock errors
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 73 (Complete the first item on your repair list using the portal's matching question set; mark it and tick it off.)
intro: Find the topic of the first item on your repair list, do those questions, mark them with the mark scheme and tick the item off. Calculator allowed for section E and F.

questions.q: Write 0.3636... (0.36 recurring) as a fraction in its simplest form.
Write 0.1555... (0.15 with the 5 recurring) as a fraction in its simplest form.
Write x² − 10x + 7 in the form (x − a)² − b.
Solve x² + 4x − 3 = 0 by completing the square. Give your answers in surd form.

blocks.h: D. Linear and quadratic simultaneous equations

questions.q: A field measures 120 m by 85 m, both to the nearest 5 m. Work out the upper bound of its perimeter.
A walker covers 9.6 km (to 1 d.p.) in 1.2 hours (to 1 d.p.). Work out the lower bound of the average speed.

blocks.h: F. Percentages: repeated change and reverse percentages

questions.q: A car worth £18 000 loses 12% of its value each year. Work out its value after 3 years.
After a 25% increase a price is £95. Work out the price before the increase.
